svg.title: HazBot front view and visualization workstation
svg.desc: Full user-supplied front-view photograph. Laptop is a visualization workstation; the photograph does not move native ML inference off the Raspberry Pi. Ball is a nonhazardous task surrogate. Photograph alone does not establish autonomous mission performance. Numbered component key: 1: laptop visualization; 2: lidar scanner; 3: articulated arm; 4: gripper; 5: csi camera; 6: mobile base; 7: ball surrogate.
